verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a general App API for fetching data and data-out integrations for sending data to analytics platforms/warehouses, plus an MCP server that can 'read workspace data', suggesting some API access to workspace metrics. However, there is no explicit documentation of endpoints specifically for campaign/broadcast/flow performance metrics (open rates, click rates, conversions) that a developer could pull into a warehouse or BI tool. Missing for 10: explicit reporting/metrics API endpoints for broadcasts and journeys, documented schema for performance data, and independent confirmation that these metrics are exposed via the App API or data-out integrations.
